figures.name: figure_1_native_physical_timeline
figures.scope: Three-second excerpt from one qualified Start. D inactivity is observed only inside captured empty-engine epochs. Unknown D time is hatched.

figures.name: figure_2_P_queue_and_credit
figures.scope: The detailed queue-status audit confirms uncomputed prompt waiters. The title does not imply that Coordinator outstanding requests are compute-ready.

figures.name: figure_3_censored_D_idle_windows
figures.scope: Only qualified captured intervals appear. These intervals are not certified Decode-safe compute budgets.

figures.name: figure_4_static_layer_selection
figures.scope: N64, one Start per arm. The red Decode line is the unchanged 5% target. No confidence interval or sustainable capacity claim.

figures.name: figure_5_heldout_N128_confirmation
figures.scope: Paired Start-unit bootstrap intervals. Individual Start ratios remain visible. Three starts have limited statistical power.

figures.name: figure_6_request_execution_enclosures
figures.scope: Hatched intervals are CUDA-event enclosures. Red points mark measured first output. Gaps are not labeled GPU idle. Independent Start origins align at the same request arrival.

figures.name: figure_7_final_text_enabled_confirmation
figures.scope: Independent held-out arrival Starts. Three Start-unit bootstrap intervals have limited power. Text output remains enabled for all methods.

figures.name: figure_8_actual_migration_kernels
figures.scope: Full-capture execution only. Copy intervals include memcpy and memcpy2 records. Observer ratios and trace integrity are in the source JSON. These intervals do not certify clean Decode-safe capacity.

figures.name: actual_migration_timeline.html
figures.scope: Interactive zoom of the actual instrumented execution. No clean idle or counterfactual speedup claim.

missing_data_policy: No unexecuted arm is filled with zero. Structural diagrams and modeled estimates are not mixed into measured timelines.
